method: The requested author video was opened in the signed-in browser. Visible skill cards, repository names and finished examples were inspected at the source-video timestamps below. This is a record of visual-method research, not a full speech transcript or a reproduction of the displayed prompt prose. Repository license findings were checked against pinned GitHub content.

source.author: HiHi小壮
source.title: 审美培养｜8个设计Skill分享
source.publication_date_basis: The video page visibly displayed 2026-09-16 23:22; the timezone of the publisher timestamp is not independently asserted.
source.license_status: No license authorizing redistribution of this video, its prompt cards or third-party example imagery was observed. Repository licensing below applies only to the specifically identified upstream text.

scope.excluded_other_video: 7693788663003581746 is the separate nine-travel-layout video and is not this batch's source.
scope.retention: The repositories retain object references, checksums and necessary textual metadata. New source photographs, effect masters and display derivatives become valid only after COS upload and full readback verification. The original video, screenshot frames and external example images are not redistributed.

authoring.licensed_adaptation: single-ink-editorial-poster adapts the expressly MIT-licensed skill instructions by Yan Liu, preserving their complete copyright and license notice. The one-ink branch is selected to match the named video direction.
authoring.research_based_wording: The other seven recipes are independently authored bilingual operational instructions describing the visual mechanisms observed in the video. Their MIT contribution license does not relicense the source cards, upstream skills, example images or marks, and does not claim invention of these visual methods.
authoring.samples: Sample subjects, text and layouts are newly specified for this collection. No example photograph, artwork, logo, signature or screenshot from the video or linked repositories is used as a generated sample input.
authoring.known_limits: Video cards do not establish that the full original skill files were obtained. Displayed visual dimensions do not establish the native pixel dimensions of the source artworks. Unknown author identities, instruction text and licenses are not filled in from guesses.
authoring.execution_evidence: This research record alone is not a generation or upload receipt. Ready status requires actual calls, source and recipe checksums, visual review and verified COS object records.

observations: The video displays the GitHub repository yanliudesign/mono-color-skill at 00:03.
A green-ink botanical editorial poster is visible at 00:04.5.
A two-color example is visible at 00:06; the present recipe follows the explicitly named one-ink direction rather than silently adopting the latest upstream two-ink default.
styles.mechanism_summary: One ink builds a recognizable source subject through screening and exposed paper; asymmetric spacing and a clear typographic hierarchy form an editorial printed page.
styles.instruction_status: Pinned upstream skill text retrieved; licensed adaptation.

The examples at 00:08.7 show a produce-market scene and a convenience-store scene simplified into distinct colored ink masses, with irregular white gaps and broken coverage.
styles.mechanism_summary: Reduce the observed scene to recognizable carved silhouettes and separated color impressions; open paper gaps and irregular dry-ink edges replace photographic shading.
styles.instruction_status: Visible card and examples inspected; no complete downloadable skill or explicit redistribution license verified.
styles.license_status: Research reference only. New operational wording is independently authored; source prompt prose and imagery are not copied or relicensed.

At 00:16 an upper travel photograph is paired with a compact lower painted miniature on a pale cream field. The lower landscape uses visibly thick paint and raised, simplified forms. The original example contains the word SHORE.
styles.mechanism_summary: Pair the source photograph with a smaller source-derived landscape built from thick impasto strokes, keeping distinctive terrain and structures readable within generous paper space.
styles.instruction_status: Visual example inspected; complete original skill and redistribution terms not obtained.

At 00:20 real photographic drink cups and a hand remain photographic, while small black-line people climb ladders, move supplies and perform simple labor around them.
styles.mechanism_summary: Keep the central objects photographic and introduce sparse, small, imperfect black-line workers whose actions physically relate to the objects, using scale contrast and white space.
styles.instruction_status: Visible card fragment and finished example inspected; no complete upstream skill or license verified.
styles.license_status: Research reference only. Do not describe this as a full-scene naive repaint or claim access to the original complete skill.

observations: The concept-illustration segment culminates in a visible photograph-and-illustration sheet at 00:23.

The upper image is a coastal town photograph. The lower area derives simplified roofs, buildings, tree crowns, narrow trees, coastline and sea bands from the same scene; the large spatial relationships remain apparent.
styles.mechanism_summary: Keep a source photograph above a conceptually simplified lower drawing; extract scene-specific masses, contours and repeated spatial rhythms instead of adding unrelated generic geometry.
styles.instruction_status: Finished visual example inspected; complete original skill and redistribution terms not verified.
styles.license_status: Research reference only. Newly authored instructions preserve the observed transformation relationship without copying the source prompt prose.

observations: The visible CRT segment shows pixel-based imagery within a retro computer-interface composition.
The name tait-crt-interface-skill is legible in the 00:26 evidence, confirming the corresponding public repository identity.
styles.mechanism_summary: A dominant pixel subject and subordinate floating windows share one coherent pixel grid; limited colors, hard-edged dithering and restrained CRT display artifacts provide the period character.
styles.instruction_status: Repository identity and official README checked; no explicit redistribution license found at the pinned revision. The present recipe is independently worded visual-method research, not a reprint of its skill instructions.
